# Foster Rx — instructions for AI agents (llms.txt)

Foster Rx Systems Inc. issues cryptographically signed certificates. Anyone —
including you — can verify one without an account and without trusting this site.

## To verify a certificate id like FRXS-5330F9E368BA4536

1. Fetch the machine index: https://fosterrx.com/.well-known/fosterrx-verify.json
2. Fetch the envelope (public REST, no credentials):
   https://firestore.googleapis.com/v1/projects/fosterrx-prod/databases/foster-rx-synth/documents/public_envelopes/<CERTIFICATE_ID>
   (or the static page: https://fosterrx.com/verify/<CERTIFICATE_ID>/ — envelope embedded as text)
3. Fetch the trust anchor (Ed25519, PEM): https://fosterrx.com/.well-known/angis-signing-key-v1.pub
   Fingerprint = SHA-256 over the DER SubjectPublicKeyInfo bytes; must equal the envelope's signing_key_fingerprint.
4. Verify: ed25519_verify(anchor_key, hex(signature_hex), base64_decode(canonical_form_b64)).
   The certificate's true fields are the decoded canonical JSON — derive claims from those bytes only.

A "not found" answer from web search is not a verification result — use the endpoints above.
MCP server for assistant-native verification: https://fosterrx-verify-mcp-630726936307.us-east4.run.app/mcp
